main.description: Get the site configuration for a repository, if one exists.

repoDid.description: DID of the repository as minted by the knot.

config.description: Site config for the repository. Absent if no site is configured.

errors.name: NotOwner
errors.description: The account does not own this repository.

errors.name: RepoNotFound
errors.description: No repository record publishes this repo DID.

errors.name: OwnershipUnverifiable
errors.description: Repository ownership could not be verified.

dir.description: Directory within the repository to deploy (e.g. '/' or '/docs').

isIndex.description: Whether this repo serves as the index (root) for the domain.
